thread:
Ava (CEO): thanks for the great questions today. quick pulse check: what's the single takeaway we want everyone to repeat about our strategy?
Theo (Dir. Marketing): short line: "Serving-first inference that makes performance predictable and costs measurable."
Elena (Customer Success): customer-facing tweak: add "deployment options" for security teams. so: predictability + economics + deployment options.
Sam (VP Product): product POV: keep it tight but add a tactical bulleted list in internal playbooks: 1) hosted = quick win 2) dedicated = predictable capacity 3) private = compliance.
Priya (Head of Research): research note: when we say "predictable" we need a clear definition for engineers & metrics folks. p50/p95/p99, request types, and a canonical load profile.
Omar (Eng): agree. can we land on a single default load profile for marketing demos and internal perf claims?
Ava (CEO): yes. Priya + Omar please propose a default profile and a short description we can reuse.
Priya (Head of Research): will do. propose: 8 concurrent streams, avg len 64 tokens, 99th percentile target = 500ms on curated models. will share details.
Theo (Dir. Marketing): once we have that, we can create a one-slide claim + a footnote that points to the benchmark repo.
Elena (Customer Success): also capture the customer story format: problem, what we changed (cache/quantize/routing), outcome (latency/cost), next step. 2-line template.
Sam (VP Product): action items: Sam -> produce internal one-pager mapping claims to acceptance criteria. Priya/Omar -> default profile + reproducible script. Theo -> marketing TL;DR and slide. Elena -> CS 2-line case template.
Ava (CEO): timeline: internal artifacts in 10 business days; customer-ready decks in 18 business days. owners above.
Omar (Eng): quick Q: who signs off on SLA language? legal or product?
Sam (VP Product): product drafts SLA language; legal signs off. will loop in legal early.
Priya (Head of Research): competitor question: can we prioritize the top 3 competitor claims for rebuttal? I can collect signals but need product/sales input on which have the biggest impact.
Theo (Dir. Marketing): from win/loss: 1) cheaper at scale, 2) single-tenant baked in, 3) "faster kernel" claims. Those are the top three.
Elena (Customer Success): add: complexity of migration is another recurring concern.
Ava (CEO): good. Priya please assemble a short competitor-signal doc labeled by impact. Sam + Jordan (sales) can prioritize rebuttal artifacts.
ops-bot: (system) Reminder: strategy-docs review meeting scheduled in 7 days -> calendar invite sent.
Omar (Eng): thanks, will slot time.
Sam (VP Product): i'll post owners + JIRA tasks after this thread.
Ava (CEO): appreciate it. keep messaging simple and let the numbers do the talking. :sparkles:
